name: Himitsu no Mahou Shoujo Pasotti-chan ~Shoutai wa Ore-sama na Senpai ♂~
original_name: 秘密の魔法少女パソティちゃん～正体はオレサマな先輩♂～
source:
Sakashita Kirinashi is the kind of girl who prefers dreaming about the future over thinking about the past. She's been living her ordinary life, until the senior she looks up to at school approached her!

"Are you really telling me I have to fight monsters now?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17962]Freem![/url]]
translation:
坂下桐无是那种更喜欢梦想未来而不是思考过去的女孩。她一直过着平凡的生活，直到学校里她仰慕的学长走近了她！

“你真的告诉我现在必须与怪物战斗吗？”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17962]Freem![/url]]
